title: 2024 RAV4 Hybrid real highway MPG after 8k miles
body: Highway mostly 70mph, getting about 38-40 mpg in mild weather. City is closer to 36. Winter dropped ~15%. No major issues yet besides occasional brake squeal when cold.
comments: Same here on 2023 Limited — winter killed my MPG.
Brake squeal is common; dealer said normal for hybrid regen.

title: Long-term reliability after 45k miles
body: Still rock solid. Only dealer visits were oil and tire rotations. Infotainment lagged once and needed a reboot. Rear seat room is excellent for kids.

title: 3.5 EcoBoost towing 7k lbs — transmission hesitation?
body: When towing my boat the 10-speed sometimes hunts between gears on mild grades. Power is great otherwise. 2024 software update supposedly helps.
comments: Update the PCM/TCM calibration — fixed my 2023.
2.7 is fine for daily, 3.5 for towing.
